title: MediVision AI: Real-Time Diagnostic Assistance & Diagnostic Triaging Engine

viva_qa.a: We chose Python for its rich ecosystem of data processing libraries and rapid prototyping tools, combined with React to deliver a responsive, latency-optimized user experience.
viva_qa.q: Why did you choose this specific technology stack over alternatives?

viva_qa.a: The backend pipeline features an input validation and sanitization layer that validates schemas, flags confidence scores below a 70% threshold, and provides graceful fallback responses.
viva_qa.q: How does your system handle invalid or out-of-distribution input data?

viva_qa.a: Employs federated lightweight vision models with explainable Grad-CAM heatmaps for clinician trust. Architected using Python and React.
viva_qa.q: What is the key novelty or innovation in your project compared to existing products?

viva_qa.a: By containerizing services with Docker, deploying behind an NGINX load balancer, migrating from JSON storage to PostgreSQL with Redis caching, and decoupling heavy inference tasks into async Celery workers.
viva_qa.q: How would you scale this project from an MVP to a production commercial system?
